description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for managing products in a grocery backend application. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, searching, creating, updating, and deleting products, with role-based access control for certain operations.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: REST controller managing CRUD operations and search functionalities for products in the grocery backend.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Product entity to its API response DTO.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all products.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a single product by its ID.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Searches products by name using a query parameter.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product, restricted to admin role.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product by ID, restricted to admin role.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID, restricted to admin role.
